games.name: Battle Bears Gold - Bling Pack: Weapon, Rare Songs & Gas
Battle Bears Gold - Classic Skins & Jukebox Songs
Battle Bears Gold - Gold Skins Pack
Battle Bears Gold - Overclock Skins, Weapons & Jukebox Song
Don Bradman Cricket Jr
games.summary: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

games.name: 100 Hidden Relics
games.summary: Find 100 hidden relics as a renegade knight. Explore a small town and its surrounding lands in this short dark fantasy hidden-object game.

games.name: 1daYs
games.summary: 1daYs is a 2D narrative adventure game where everyday life and small mysteries intertwine.

games.name: Aerofactory
games.summary: Name your company, fetch your staff, submit your offers to the tenders and dominate the local and international markets.

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary: From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali ZEGO zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory... three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Another Cat's Tale
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person puzzle adventure filled with exploration and puzzles. A dark fairy tale woven into the walls of an old cursed house.

games.name: Apocalipsis Survivor
games.summary: Survive the horde. Find the source. End the plague.

games.name: Apple Catcher
games.summary: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion-controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid sticks, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

games.name: Aquarium Days
games.summary: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

games.name: Artificial Ambition
games.summary: Grow your AI startup from a 2017 garage to an industry titan. Hire specialists, train models, and outsmart rivals. Build the future, but tread carefully—your relentless drive for progress might just open a Pandora's box of unintended power.

games.name: Ashen Legacy
games.summary: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

games.name: ASTERIS
games.summary: Claim divine power in ASTERIS, an action roguelite for solo play and up to 4-player online co-op. Build your skills anew each run, master four heroes, and conquer bosses with tank, damage, and healing roles. Keep your gear and permanent growth for the next challenge.

games.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: Build the Hole
games.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: Cabinet Fever
games.summary: Run an arcade from 1972 to 1998. Buy cabinets, set the prices, keep them repaired and play every one of the 31 machines yourself: each is a real, playable game. Grow from a corner nook into a neon megaplex as the years roll by.

games.name: Captive 3000
games.summary: Old-school sci-fi first-person real-time dungeon crawler. Grid-based movement. Traditional sprite design. Inspired by classic 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master, Eye of the Beholder, and the Amiga/Atari masterpiece Captive.

games.name: Card Slay
games.summary: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Chase the flush, sweat the last discard, then slam it down and watch the damage hit: red suits strike, black suits shield. The monsters read your hand, call your ranks and cheat, so stack your ritual deck, out-cheat them, and slay your fate.

games.name: Cash is King! - The Official Book
Cat Caffeine
games.summary: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced Action Roguelite that combines frantic combat, precision platforming and unique builds across procedurally generated planets. Every run offers new ways to play, death is permanent. Can you survive the cat-astrophe?

games.name: Catnigma
games.summary:
Steal fish in the most magical and sneaky way possible!

Catnigma is a magical puzzle game where you control a flying cat on a quest to satisfy its endless hunger for fish. The cat moves continuously in the chosen direction until it hits an obstacle, and it’s up to you to use your wits and magical tricks to collect every fish in the level.

Once you’ve gathered them all, return to the Magic Box to unlock the next challenge!
With a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere, original music, and enchanting visuals, each stage feels like exploring a quiet, nighttime home.

Search every corner: living room, kitchen, and bedroom – no fish is safe from your magical cat!

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Coverage
games.summary: A board game for two players similar to games like Othello and Ataxx. Cover the board with your pieces--or take over all of your opponent's.

games.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
games.summary: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

games.name: Cuby Clicker
games.summary: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

games.name: Curiosity Kills
games.summary: Curiosity is what gets you in. Teamwork is what gets you out. Explore a forgotten research facility as a crew of curious monkeys: haul loot, dodge horrors, grind monsters, unlock wild cosmetics, and survive together. Free-to-play co-op horror in VR and on flat screen.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

games.name: DeepCorp Rescue
games.summary: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

games.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
games.summary: Wildly satisfying incremental shooter! Gun down desktop bugs, farm resources to upgrade skill trees, and wield wild weapons like flamethrowers & exorcism cameras. Total stress buster for quick work breaks! Perfect casual stress relief game for your breaks.

games.name: Desktop Fireworks Festival
games.summary: Desktop Fireworks Festival is a management game where your desktop becomes the venue for your very own fireworks festival. Grow your festival into a grand venue and fill your desktop sky with a spectacular fireworks display of your own!

games.name: Diamonds and Spades
games.summary: At first glance, Diamonds and Spades looks like a simple card game. But then you discover powerful combos and achieve absurdly high scores. Collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities and create your own cards in the editor.

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.summary: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

games.name: Digging Up
games.summary: simple ruleskill all the viruses with colored capsules,four or more capsule halves or viruses of matching color are aligned in vertical or horizontal configurations, they are removed.easy to play: wipe left, right or down to move the capsule, Tap to rotate.Choose initial level and speed as you like.multiple viruses are eliminated at once yield more points.higher speed levels yield more points.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: DriveGear
games.summary: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

games.name: DYTH
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

games.name: Endless Shift: Haunted House
games.summary: A cozy Halloween restaurant game! You're the ghost waiter of a haunted hotel: seat vampires, mummies and werewolves, serve potions and monstrous dishes, and dress up in Halloween costumes, all before their patience runs out!

games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
games.summary: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a unified 4v4 team sport. Across shared middle ranks, pieces migrate between boards to flank opponents and save teammates. A true multi-board competitive variant built to completely revolutionize the team chess format!

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

games.name: ESCAPE SHOW
games.summary: A game show where eight people are locked in identical rooms and only one knows the way out — and that person is not allowed to speak. Read the master's mime, finish the tasks, raid your neighbour's room, and get out before the gas. Best played shouting.

games.name: False Feed
games.summary: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different perspectives in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: Find & Collect: Cats Edition
games.summary: Try to find the “cat” hidden somewhere! If the “cat” is hard to find, you can color it in to make it easier to spot! Just find the “cat,” and the “Cat Encyclopedia” will be unlocked!

games.name: Floaterra
games.summary: Build and expand a floating settlement in Floaterra, a single-player farming and automation game. Grow crops, craft machines, organize production, and put robot helpers to work, with your RoboPet at your side.

games.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator
games.summary: Eternal idol or washed-up talent? Futbolero blends a football career sim, choice-driven roguelite, and key arcade minigames. Every run is a new life: from the streets to glory, juggling contracts, parties, and dynasties. Play solo or with friends in co-op or competitive PvP.

games.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
games.summary: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

games.name: Green Gas
games.summary: 3–5 Cells. One hidden Cancer.???? Which one will you become????? Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

games.name: Grim Guild
games.summary: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back.

games.name: GrindFall
games.summary: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

games.name: GuruGuru Cannon
games.summary: GuruGuru Cannon is a fast-paced 2D swinging action score attack game that delivers satisfying gameplay with intuitive controls. Use simple one-button controls to send the ball flying across the field! Score as many points as possible within 60 seconds!

games.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
games.summary: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: Hazzard Hearth
games.summary: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

games.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Heavy Defense
HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
games.summary: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

games.name: HOLLOWSIM: Industrial Voidline Defense
games.summary: A retro-styled space strategy and simulation game where you build, defend, and expand an industrial foothold in a hostile sector. Manage ships, structures, resources, and escalating threats as you grow from a fragile station into a resilient operation.

games.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
games.summary: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

games.name: Hyakui Pan
games.summary: Imagine you own this fancy beauty salon and you have to prove your talents by changing this girl's look the way you want. Begin with her hairstyle and hair color, use some makeup on her face, eyes and lips and then pick up a cute shirt to dress her up. Don't forget to also choose some accessories to complete her chic look! Enjoy!Game Instructions / ControlsUse the finger to drag and drop the hair tools and the clothes, and to click on the make up items to change the girl's look.Good Luck!

games.name: Impossible Draw
games.summary:
-==TAKE A TRANQUILIZING TRIP INTO CYBERSPACE==-

Mimic the signs of virtuality to progress through a world where colors, shapes and music forms an ecstatic atmosphere. Draw symbols, collect bytes and enjoy the hypnotic mix of audiovisual harmony!

Test your drawing skills, while your mind will be carried to an ever-changing computer space made from relaxing elements. Impossible Draw was built upon the basic concept that even the world's most trivial looking symbol can be challenging if you try to draw it accurately. If you're up to the challenge, Impossible Draw rewards your efforts with various unlockable extras, which makes it an even deeper, dream-like experience. Customize your trips (as you try to master your skills) with various game modes, special effects and soundtracks. Therefore, every replay could be a unique experience.

games.name: In Mutable Form - The Making and Philosophy of The Bull of Heaven
Isle Of Thundir
games.summary: Explore the world, Discover Villages, Build a magnificent fortress and defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and administer their needs. Defend your fort well or lose everything.

games.name: JapaneseDialect
games.summary: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

games.name: Junkyard Reseller
games.summary: Choose an AWESOME BLOCK MAN and race your way through the streets!! Be careful you don't crash into the Harlem Shakers, SCARY zombies, stick men and the ninjas....!!!!!!!!

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kemonomimi Territory
games.summary: There’s only room for one kemonomimi tribe on the island. Recruit your army, claim hexes and capture rival bases to be the last tribe standing. Play this single-player, turn-based virtual board game in VR or on desktop.

games.name: Lil Laundry Lane
games.summary: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

games.name: LINE WARLORD
games.summary: A real-time line-battle roguelite. Spend rations to summon swordsmen, shields, archers and cavalry onto a single front, then break the enemy base. Pick relics and promotions at every fork to build a different army each run. Three commanders, three ultimates.

games.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
games.summary: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

games.name: Love Joy Happiness
games.summary: Short incremental game about things that are important in your life.

games.name: Love n Life: Happy Student - Winter Embrace
Magic Ball Sort
games.summary: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

games.name: Mallet Mayhem '84
games.summary: Step up to a colourful 1980s arcade table in Mallet Mayhem '84. Guide your mallet with the mouse, line up bank shots, face three AI difficulty levels, or challenge a Steam friend in private online 1v1. Play best-of-three matches from two camera views.

games.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
games.summary: Grow, nurture and sell exquisite flowers from your own shop in old France. Plant seeds, tend each bloom with care, master dozens of species, and build a thriving florist as customers come seeking the perfect bouquet — all in first person, at your own peaceful pace.

games.name: Math Time
games.summary: 45 seconds, 15 questions, one rival. Math Time is a fast 1v1 math duel: race real players or quirky math machines, pick the right answer from three choices and climb the leaderboard. Daily quests, day streaks and friend duels keep you coming back.

games.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
games.summary: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

games.name: Monster Club League Manager
games.summary: Take charge of a monster club and aim for the Division 1 title in this single-player management sim. Recruit and develop players, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, and club finances. Matches play out automatically as you build your squad over many seasons.

games.name: Moon Swarm
games.summary: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

games.name: Moto Rogue
games.summary: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

games.name: Neuville Survivors
games.summary: Play a Survival game that combines Exploration and Tower Defense, and discover why on Neuville, the AI does not want humans on the planet.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Nie Xiaoqian
games.summary: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

games.name: Nino: the Persuader
games.summary: A narrative strategy game about words, power, and consequence. Play as Nino: a persuader navigating six rival nations where every dialogue choice shifts the balance of trust, faith, and hostility across an entire world.

games.name: Nonet Concerto R
games.summary: Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and battle monsters with a wide range of spells in this third-person, loot-driven 3D action game. Experiment with different builds across more than 50 stages, solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

games.name: Not My Son
games.summary: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

games.name: Novalex Project Zero
games.summary: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
Parasite: Among the Guests
games.summary: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.

games.name: Penguin Colony (Broanater)
games.summary: Send your penguins waddling off to gather pebbles, fish the Shore and grow a bustling colony. Buy upgrades until the whole flock works on its own, then Migrate for Feathers and come back stronger. A cosy incremental game with a real ending, and an Endless mode if you never want to stop.

games.name: PlayASM
games.summary: Build a computer from the inside out. Write real assembly, watch every register and byte change live, then draw graphics, compose chiptune music, program a robot arm and build 3D voxel worlds. 100+ missions. Full mod support. No black boxes.

games.name: PROPERTY INSPECTION
games.summary: Property Inspection is a short first-person psychological horror game about completing a routine inspection of Unit 47. Examine the apartment, document structural issues, follow your checklist, and finish the job when the final task stops making sense.

games.name: Psychotrons
games.summary: Psychotrons is a point and click in the wake of Monkey Island, there is no game over. 90+ challenges/screens where the player collects Lost Neurons and convinces the Psychotrons to give up them engaging in absurd conversation. There is no graphic violence and it is a full OFF-LINE game.

games.name: Pushlings
games.summary: Pushlings is a competitive multiplayer game where players compete to accumulate the highest number of points through movement. Each step counts toward the score, while enemies appear throughout the match and other players compete for space by pushing each other.

games.name: Quiver Story
games.summary: You are the last archer of the Quiver Watch. Hold the line, charge your shot, and put down what the mountain sends before it reaches the village.

games.name: Ragdoll Robotics
games.summary: Ragdoll Robotics is a physics puzzle game packed with explosive chain reactions. Place mines, spikes, launchers and turrets, send your robot through the test chamber, and refine your setup to beat each level’s challenge.

games.name: Retail Nation: My Supermarket
games.summary: Build, customize and manage your own supermarket in this first-person retail simulation. Order stock, fill shelves, serve customers, manage and develop employees, and grow a small shop into a thriving supermarket.

games.name: Rules of the Inn
games.summary: You know the rules. You still can't be sure what you just saw was real. A room in an inn on the border of the afterlife; each night, another rule. What comes for you is drawn fresh - no two nights are alike. Lower your eyes, cover your ears, judge the wrongness. Judge wrong, and morning never comes.

games.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
games.summary:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

Key Features:
• Meet and interact with multiple android heroines, each with a unique design, traits, and branching storylines.
• Navigate romantic, dramatic, and suspenseful storylines by making impactful decisions.
• A blend of visual novel intimacy and sci-fi adventure.
• An immersive, futuristic world inspired by cyberpunk romance and emotional AI testing.

games.name: Seashells & Shovels
games.summary: Volunteer to clean tourist islands and seize the chance to hunt pirate treasure. Sail between 12 colorful islands, bag litter, scrub away paint, follow maps, dig up buried finds, and make your ship a home in a cozy first-person adventure.

games.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

games.name: Shove Nova
games.summary: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

games.name: Slay the Tire
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder on two wheels. Choose one of four outlaws, build your deck, collect powerful gas cans, and battle across America's back roads. Every turn becomes a cinematic motorcycle chase through deserts, bayous, cities, and coastal storms.

games.name: Sort Them Fish
games.summary: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

games.name: Soul Snake 3D
games.summary: Slither through seven cursed biomes as a snake that grows into a weapon. Eat prey, auto-fire venom darts, and build a run from 68 upgrade cards and 9 evolutions. Topple each biome's guardian, bank souls for permanent upgrades, and see how long you last in endless Survival.

games.name: Spice Pound
games.summary: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

games.name: StoneEra
games.summary: Build, manage, and expand a medieval voxel colony in a procedurally generated world. Gather resources, assign AI-controlled villagers, reshape the terrain, survive changing seasons, and grow your settlement block by block.

games.name: Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator
games.summary: THINK YOU KNOW YOUR ACTION FILMS? Prove it in this easy to use addictive quiz. * Guess a movie from a picture of a key scene.* Guess the action film actors name.* 10 Levels to guess* Auto complete to stop spelling issues* Daily reward hintsOver 200 images to guess from.Tons of fun so download today. All rights, content and trademarks are owned by their respective owners and not associated to fun-apps.

games.name: Table Of Truth
games.summary: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

games.name: TAKEN
games.summary: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
games.summary: You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb — through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs. Start with one.

games.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
games.summary: A king is dead with no heir. In a capital where four houses sharpen their blades over an empty throne, you are a wandering mercenary looking for work. Left or right — one swipe decides a life. A dark-fantasy, choice-driven roguelite where, whatever you do, in the end you will not be remembered.

games.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold'em
